handbookNote: Source: Maryland MVA Driver's Manual (DL-002), October 2025 Edition, fetched directly from mva.maryland.gov (official PDF at mva.maryland.gov/media/148, 7.6MB, updated 2025-12-01) and converted to text at temp/handbooks/md/driver.txt. Real exam mechanics CONFIRMED (not assumed) from two independent official mva.maryland.gov pages (prepare-drivers-license-test/knowledge-tests and driver-education-safety/maryland-drivers-manuals) AND from the handbook's own Section 1.B text: Class C (standard noncommercial) knowledge test has 25 questions, 20-minute time limit, and a required passing score of 88% or higher (22 of 25 correct). Test also confirmed untimed-retake rules (next business day after 1st fail, 7-day wait after 2+ fails) and score validity of 6 months -- these are not used in question content, only cited here for completeness. All 256 questions are grounded in specific, distinct facts pulled directly from the fetched handbook text (numeric thresholds, GDL timelines, right-of-way rules, sign/signal meanings, pavement marking types, work-zone light colors, no-zone truck blind spots, Move Over Law fine tiers, GDL restriction/penalty ladders, medical-reporting conditions, seat belt/child-seat/insurance rules, bicycle equipment law, and e-bike/low-speed-vehicle classes). Content-depth rationale: Maryland's 54-page manual (10 sections) is detailed and fact-dense but noticeably shorter than some other states' handbooks; 256 distinct, non-repetitive, well-grounded questions is judged the honest ceiling this specific manual supports across 12 topic buckets without resorting to invented facts, restated questions, or filler -- this lands within the site's normal 250-300 pool range without stretching thin content.
